data.name: Gender Gap in Spanish WP
data.abstract: Data set used to estimate the number of women editors and their editing practices in the Spanish Wikipedia

intro_paper.title: Exploring the gender gap in the Spanish Wikipedia: Differences in engagement and editing practices
intro_paper.authors: J. Minguillón, J. Meneses, E. Aibar, Núria Ferran-Ferrer, Sergi Fàbregues

variables.name: gender
variables.description: 0 (unknown), 1 (male), 2 (female)

variables.name: C_api
variables.description: gender extracted from WikiMedia API, codes as female / male / unknown

variables.name: C_man
variables.description: gender extracted from content coding, coded as 1 (male) / 2 (female) / 3 (unknown)

variables.name: E_NEds
variables.description: I index of stratum IJ (0,1,2,3)

variables.name: E_Bpag
variables.description: J index of stratum IJ (0,1,2,3)

variables.name: firstDay
variables.description: first edition in the Spanish Wikipedia (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS)

variables.name: lastDay
variables.description: last edition in the Spanish Wikipedia (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS)

variables.name: NEds
variables.description: total number of editions

variables.name: NDays
variables.description: number of days (lastDay-firstDay+1)

variables.name: NActDays
variables.description: number of days with editions

variables.name: NPages
variables.description: number of different pages edited

variables.name: NPcreated
variables.description: number of pages created

variables.name: pagesWomen
variables.description: number of edits in pages related to women

variables.name: wikiprojWomen
variables.description: number of edits in WikiProjects related to women

variables.name: ns_user
variables.description: number of edits in namespace user

variables.name: ns_wikipedia
variables.description: number of edits in namespace wikipedia

variables.name: ns_talk
variables.description: number of edits in namespace talk

variables.name: ns_userTalk
variables.description: number of edits in namespace user talk

variables.name: ns_content
variables.description: number of edits in content pages

variables.name: weightIJ
variables.description: correcting weight for stratum IJ

variables.name: NIJ
variables.description: number of elements in stratum IJ
